items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I think Nat Hentoff called me and told me where to be.

ctx.x: Well, I just got this call, you know how New York is, you get a phone call you don't know what it is or how important it's going to be. There's no big production about anything, you know. So I got a -- I think Nat Hentoff called me and told me where to be. I was there and I saw all of these musicians, you know, getting together. Had no idea what it was about. And I think Milt Hinton, the great bass player, took movies of everybody moving about, color movies.
I think you said Milt showed them to you.
